title: VIRTUAL SINGER Chapter1 Episode14 A Step Towards Reconciliation

rows.Line: Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Time to open up shop.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I hope today is going to be another wonderful day.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, Rin? What are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: MEIKO! Well, you see...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: A-Actually, never mind! I should get going.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Are you sure? It sounds like you came here for a reason.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yes...but if anybody were to overhear...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Don't worry.
I just opened, so there's no one here yet.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Would you like to come inside for a minute?
You can order any drink you like. It's on me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, thank you, MEIKO.
I suppose I could stay for a little while.
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Sigh.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Rin, you look like something's bothering you. Are you and Len still arguing?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah... We've never had a fight last this long before. I don't know what to do.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see. What started it?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Well, we both really wanted to sing the same part of our new song. We were discussing who would get to do it, but...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I got upset with him, then he started yelling back.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I ended up calling him a dummy and ignored him, so he starting doing the same thing. We've been ignoring each other ever since.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I'd hate to never be able to speak with him again.
I want to apologize, but I just can't find the courage.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see. So you'd like to apologize, but can't seem to find the right timing then?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah... I'm the one who got mad first, so this whole thing is my fault.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What am I going to do if the fight keeps going and we never talk to each other again?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I don't want that...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm willing to bet Len feels the same way you do.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? How can you be so sure?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Because I know both of you, of course.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The two of you are always together. If you want to make up with Len, then I'm sure he feels the same way.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I don't know...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I guarantee if you sit down and are as honest with him as you were with me just now, you'll make up in no time.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Like I was just now...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're right! I'll try talking to him, just like you said!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Terrific.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. There's the Rin I know so well.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Here, consider this my little gift to show my support.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? Is this a lemon soda?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's right. You two always order those when you're in here together.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah. Your lemon sodas are always so good.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I sure hope Len and I can drink them together again soon.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: All right, I've decided I'm going to go find Len and apologize!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Sorry MEIKO, but I can't drink this just yet.
I want to share it with Len.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. I understand. Good luck.
I hope you two can make up soon.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thanks, MEIKO! I'll be sure to come back with Len!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: See you soon!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I suppose that means I should get another lemon soda ready.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hey MEIKO, I thought I saw Rin come in here a little while ago.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hm? She's not here?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. She and Len will be back soon.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That would explain the two lemon sodas.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yep. It seems as though the cafe may finally see some lively conversation again. I'm looking forward to it.
